name: Home insurance
shortDescription: Cover for your home and belongings after fire, storm, or water damage.
description: Mock home insurance for a house or apartment. Use this card to prototype comparison, eligibility, and plain-language explanations.
whoItIsFor: Homeowners and tenants who want a clear overview of what is covered.

name: Car insurance
shortDescription: Civil liability, with optional comprehensive cover for your vehicle.
description: Mock motor insurance with a simple split between legal minimum cover and extra protection. Designed for accessible product comparison.
whoItIsFor: Drivers looking for a straightforward car policy explanation.

name: Family civil liability
shortDescription: Protection if you or a family member accidentally cause damage to others.
description: Mock family insurance focused on everyday accidents at home, school, or leisure. Useful for explaining liability in plain language.
whoItIsFor: Families who want a simple safety net for everyday accidents.

name: Hospitalisation insurance
shortDescription: Help with hospital bills that go beyond standard health insurance.
description: Mock hospitalisation product for explaining deductibles, room choice, and pre/post hospital costs without real pricing engines.
whoItIsFor: People who want to understand extra medical costs before they happen.

name: Current account
shortDescription: Everyday payments, transfers, and a debit card in one place.
description: Mock current account used to visualise fees, included services, and digital banking basics.
whoItIsFor: Anyone who needs a daily spending account.

name: Savings account
shortDescription: Set money aside with a simple, visible interest rate.
description: Mock regulated-style savings account for showing interest, availability of funds, and how savings sit next to insurance products.
whoItIsFor: People who want a rainy-day buffer without investment risk.

name: Home loan
shortDescription: Borrow to buy or renovate a home, with a clear repayment picture.
description: Mock mortgage product for visualising duration, fixed vs variable rate, and related insurances such as outstanding balance cover.
whoItIsFor: Prospective buyers comparing monthly cost and related cover.

name: Investment plan
shortDescription: Regular contributions into a diversified mock fund mix.
description: Mock investment plan for explaining risk levels, time horizon, and why this is different from a savings account.
whoItIsFor: People who can leave money invested for several years.
